state.claim: Hunter Biden, son of US President Joe Biden has died.
state.query: Search for the actual April 6, 2026 court filing or docket entry by Barry Coburn in the Winston & Strawn civil suit in Washington, D.C., to obtain the primary document rather than news retellings.

candidates.title: PACER Case Locator - United States Courts
candidates.snippet: For real-time case filings, search by the court where the case is filed. Use the Court CM/ECF Lookup to find the court's specific link or log into PACER and select the court name.

candidates.title: Court Records - United States Courts
candidates.snippet: Locate a federal court case by using the Public Access to Court Electronic Records (PACER) or by visiting the Clerk’s Office of the courthouse where the case was filed.

candidates.title: Find a Case | PACER: Federal Court Records
candidates.snippet: Explore the various options for locating federal court case records electronically, including logging into PACER. Search for a case in the federal court where the case was filed. This information is updated immediately. Use the PACER Case Locator to search a nationwide index of federal court cases. This information is updated daily.

candidates.title: Advanced RECAP Archive Search for PACER – CourtListener.com
candidates.snippet: Using this archive, you can finally search and download millions of PACER documents, including those that were originally scanned PDFs, which we laboriously convert to text.

candidates.title: Find a Case (PACER) - United States Courts
candidates.snippet: PACER allows anyone with an account to search and locate appellate, district, and bankruptcy court case and docket information. Register for a PACER account. Use the PACER Case Locator if you are not sure which specific federal court the case was filed.
